ferramenta: image_gen integrada para separar estrutura; preparação física dos jatos no gerador.
prompt: Prepare this EXACT fountain game asset for separate water animation. Remove ONLY the THREE long falling streams from upper bowl to lower basin (left, center, right) and their three white foamy impact splashes. Restore clean matching sandstone of the central pillar where the center stream was. Keep the basin water itself blue with gentle small ripples but no large white impact foam circles. KEEP the small upward top spout and its water arch at the very top EXACTLY as-is to preserve top silhouette. Preserve ALL stone geometry, mouths, carved panels, bowl shapes, perspective, dimensions, composition, base position, lighting and hand-painted fine detail. Do not redesign or move anything. Background true transparent alpha, including gaps beside pillar. No colored halos in transparent pixels. Same canvas and object size/placement. This is the static background for simulated falling streams.
animacao: Simulação em tempo real a30Hz nas duas bacias: equação de ondas discreta, amortecimento e reflexão nas bordas; impactos balísticos injetam energia. Cinco jatos com gravidade, afinamento por velocidade e respingos. Shader desloca/reflete água conforme o campo de alturas. Pedra fixa; sem ciclo de sprites da água.
